links.outcome: Appropriateness of ChatGPT medication consultation responses rated by pharmacists
links.effect: Appropriateness was higher for public questions than for health care provider questions (31/51, 61% vs 20/51, 39%; P=.01), showing many inappropriate responses. Erroneous information was linked to potential medical risks.
links.quote: ChatGPT exhibited a higher appropriateness rate in responding to public medication consultation questions compared to those asked by health care providers in a hospital setting (31/51, 61% vs 20/51, 39%; P=.01).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and appropriateness of ChatGPT on real-world medication consultation and drug-herb interaction questions via expert pharmacist review, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
